design.title: naeil-ui
design.subtitle: Design System Showcase — Tokens · Components · Themes
design.neutralDescription: Actions and selection use neutral semantic colors in both themes. Focus and feedback have separate roles.
design.primitiveDescription: Primitive palettes remain available for compatibility. The blue scale is a legacy primitive, not the default action color.
design.semanticDescription: These roles follow the active light or dark theme. Colors below are read from the shared CSS variables.
design.projectDescription: Project colors identify individual products. They do not replace shared action, focus, or selection roles.
design.typeDescription: Pretendard for Korean and Latin UI, Noto Sans JP for Japanese. Monospace samples use the configured fallback stack.
design.radiusDescription: Tags use 4px corners, controls 8px, and panels 12px.
design.inputHelp: Change the controls to compare input states.
design.inputError: Check this value and try again.
design.raisedDescription: Raised surfaces use the card-elevated role and a subtle shadow.
